name: Structure & Liftoff In Combustion Experiment (SLICE)
description: Evaluated laminar gas jet diffusion flames, flame liftoff dynamics, soot inception limits, and blowout boundaries in microgravity using round nozzles inside the Microgravity Science Glovebox on the International Space Station.
subresearch_area: Gaseous Jet Diffusion Flame Liftoff & Soot Structure
apparatus: 0.4 mm to 1.6 mm round gas nozzles, intensified video camera, laser diagnostic optics, co-flow air duct
